exact.3×3 核在 pad 1、stride 1 時剛好補回邊界損失，空間尺寸不變；降: With pad 1 and stride 1, a 3×3 kernel exactly makes up for the border loss, so the spatial size stays the same; reducing the resolution is left to max pooling with stride 2.
exact.前兩層各 4096，最後一層 1000 對應 ILSVRC 的 1000 類；L: The first two layers have 4096 each, and the last layer's 1000 corresponds to the 1000 ILSVRC classes; LeNet's 120-84-10 is a different architecture.
exact.unlike AlexNet，多數 VGG 不用 LRN，因實驗發現對 ILSV: Unlike AlexNet, most VGG models do not use LRN, because experiments found it gave no improvement on ILSVRC.
exact.寬度 2、stride 2 的 max pooling 使相鄰視窗不重疊，長寬各: Max pooling with width 2 and stride 2 makes adjacent windows non-overlapping, halving both the height and the width.

5b4994993c9e.zh: 牛津大學視覺幾何組（Visual Geometry Group）提出了極簡純粹的網路哲學：放棄 11×11 與 5×5 等大尺寸卷積核，清一色採用 3×3 小核深度堆疊！兩個 3×3 卷積等價 5×5 感受野，三個 3×3 卷積等價 7×7 感受野。參數量從 49 驟降至 27，同時引入三次非線性 ReLU 啟用，使特徵具備更高的辨識能力。
5b4994993c9e.en: Oxford's Visual Geometry Group proposed a minimalist, pure network philosophy: abandon large kernels such as 11×11 and 5×5 and use nothing but deeply stacked 3×3 small kernels! Two 3×3 convolutions are equivalent to a 5×5 receptive field, and three 3×3 convolutions are equivalent to a 7×7 receptive field. The parameter count plunges from 49 to 27, while three nonlinear ReLU activations are introduced, giving the features higher discriminative power.

ca9f62782046.zh:
「明明需要看見 7×7 的廣闊視野，為何硬要用三個 3×3 取代一個大 7×7？」 用深度換視野！參數量從 49 砍至 27（現省 45%），中間還多賺兩次 ReLU 非線性表達力！
Exchange depth for receptive field: parameters drop from 49 to 27 while gaining two extra non-linearities!
ca9f62782046.en: “If we clearly need to see a wide 7×7 field of view, why insist on replacing one big 7×7 with three 3×3s?” <small>Trade depth for field of view! The parameter count is cut from 49 to 27 (a 45% saving), and you earn two extra ReLU nonlinearities in between!</small>

bef7f008a2c2.zh: 02 / 感受野數學等價 · Receptive Field Math

f98a57e478a9.zh: 感受野等價定理：小核堆疊的雙重數學紅利 Mathematical Equivalence: Receptive Field Growth and Parameter Reduction
f98a57e478a9.en: Receptive field equivalence theorem: the double mathematical dividend of stacking small kernels

b3d80c054d30.zh: 堆疊卷積的感受野增長公式

63efd4603a56.zh:
當步幅 stride $=1$ 時，每堆疊一層核寬為 $k$ 的卷積，有效感受野（Effective Receptive Field）擴充套件為：
      $$\text{RF}_{l} = \text{RF}_{l-1} + (k - 1)$$
63efd4603a56.en: When the stride $=1$, each stacked convolution layer with kernel width $k$ expands the effective receptive field to: $$\text{RF}_{l} = \text{RF}_{l-1} + (k - 1)$$

ea2fea3773db.zh: 兩層 $3\times 3$： 感受野擴大為 $3 + (3 - 1) = \mathbf{5\times 5}$。參數量為 $2 \times 3^2 = 18 < 25$（節省 28%）。
ea2fea3773db.en: Two $3\times 3$ layers: the receptive field grows to $3 + (3 - 1) = \mathbf{5\times 5}$. The parameter count is $2 \times 3^2 = 18 < 25$ (a 28% saving).

305d62e978c4.zh: 三層 $3\times 3$： 感受野擴大為 $5 + (3 - 1) = \mathbf{7\times 7}$。參數量為 $3 \times 3^2 = \mathbf{27} < \mathbf{49}$（節省 45%）！
305d62e978c4.en: Three $3\times 3$ layers: the receptive field grows to $5 + (3 - 1) = \mathbf{7\times 7}$. The parameter count is $3 \times 3^2 = \mathbf{27} < \mathbf{49}$ (a 45% saving)!

70fc2835d19e.zh: 非線性維度倍增： 一個 $7\times 7$ 卷積後僅有一次 ReLU；而三層 $3\times 3$ 堆疊之間包含了三次連續的 ReLU，大幅增強了模型對高度複雜非線性特徵的分辨力。
70fc2835d19e.en: Multiplying the nonlinearity: one $7\times 7$ convolution is followed by only a single ReLU, while a stack of three $3\times 3$ layers contains three consecutive ReLUs, greatly strengthening the model's ability to distinguish highly complex nonlinear features.

189f2939d4a9.zh: VGG 規定所有 $3\times 3$ 卷積核必須搭配 stride = 1 與 padding = 1。每做一次卷積，四周補的一圈剛好補回被吃掉的邊界，因此卷積層完全不改變空間長寬解析度！
189f2939d4a9.en: VGG requires every $3\times 3$ kernel to use stride = 1 and padding = 1. With each convolution, the one-pixel ring padded around the border exactly makes up for the border that gets eaten, so the convolutional layers do not change the spatial height and width at all!

b96438025870.en: For the local response normalization (LRN) introduced by AlexNet, the Oxford team's large-scale experiments found no improvement at all on ILSVRC classification, only extra memory cost. VGG decisively removed LRN altogether.

32faa2143947.en: 📌 Key takeaways of this unit: the VGG small-kernel stacking philosophy

33baa2518c3e.zh: 深度取代大核（3×3 堆疊）： 三層 3×3 卷積視野等價於單一 7×7 大核，參數量從 49 銳減至 27，更帶來三次連續 ReLU 非線性轉換。
33baa2518c3e.en: Depth instead of big kernels (3×3 stacks): three 3×3 convolution layers see the same field as a single big 7×7 kernel, cut the parameter count sharply from 49 to 27, and bring three consecutive ReLU nonlinear transformations.

db9f8907aa2b.zh: 尺寸不變的卷積律： stride 1 搭配 pad 1，卷積層完全不縮減解析度；降取樣純粹交由 stride 2 的 2×2 Max Pooling。
db9f8907aa2b.en: The size-preserving convolution rule: with stride 1 and pad 1, the convolutional layers do not reduce resolution at all; downsampling is left purely to 2×2 max pooling with stride 2.

dca9e5f54c7c.zh: 簡約純粹主義： 捨棄複雜且無益的 LRN 正規化，證明架構的深度與規律性遠比繁瑣技巧更能提升泛化能力。
dca9e5f54c7c.en: Minimalist purism: dropping the complicated and unhelpful LRN normalization showed that the depth and regularity of an architecture improve generalization far more than fiddly tricks.

30945bd345ad.zh: 標準訓練正規化： Mini-batch SGD 配 0.9 動量、權重衰減 $5\times 10^{-4}$ 與學習率階梯衰減，奠定後續深網訓練的黃金標準！
30945bd345ad.en: Standard training recipe: mini-batch SGD with 0.9 momentum, weight decay $5\times 10^{-4}$ and a step-decayed learning rate set the gold standard for training later deep networks!
